title: DISCERN: Distributional Synthetic Replay for Retain-Free Incremental Machine Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2611.07892v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of specific training data from a trained model without retraining from scratch. In real deployments, however, deletion requests arrive over time, calling for incremental class unlearning (ICU): classes are removed sequentially, previously forgotten knowledge must remain forgotten, and the remaining classes must be preserved. We present DIstributional SynthetiC rEplay for Retain-free iNcremental unlearning (DISCERN), an intervention-based class unlearning method that replaces access to the retain set with synthetic embeddings sampled from per-class parametric distributions. Unlike prototype-based replay, which assumes an isotropic Gaussian around each class centroid, DISCERN fits Euclidean (Gaussian, Laplace, Student's $t$) and directional (von Mises--Fisher, Fisher--Bingham) families to each class and selects among them through statistical tests and, when none of them accepts, cross-valid

translated_title: DISCERN：面向无保留集增量式机器遗忘的分布性合成回放
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.07892v1 公告类型： cross 摘要：机器遗忘旨在在不从头重新训练的情况下，从已训练模型中移除特定训练数据的影响。然而在实际部署中，删除请求会随时间不断到来，这就需要增量式类遗忘（Incremental Class Unlearning, ICU）：类别被依次移除，已被遗忘的知识必须保持遗忘状态，同时剩余类别必须得到保留。我们提出了 DISCERN（DIstributional SynthetiC rEplay for Retain-free iNcremental unlearning），一种基于干预的类遗忘方法，它用从每个类别的参数化分布中采样的合成嵌入来替代对保留集的访问。与假设每个类质心周围为各向同性高斯分布的原型回放方法不同，DISCERN 为每个类别拟合欧几里得分布族（高斯、拉普拉斯、学生 t 分布）和方向性分布族（von Mises–Fisher、Fisher–Bingham），并通过统计检验从中进行选择，当没有任何分布族被接受时，则采用交叉验证……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: DISCERN 通过为每个类别拟合欧氏与方向性参数分布并采样合成嵌入进行回放，实现了无需访问保留集的增量式类遗忘，在依次删除类别的同时确保已遗忘知识不被恢复并保留剩余类别的性能。
en_tdlr: DISCERN enables retain-free incremental class unlearning by fitting per-class Euclidean and directional distributions to generate synthetic replay embeddings, sequentially removing classes while keeping previously forgotten knowledge forgotten and preserving the remaining classes.
